title: State-history forecasting for pre-onset warning of gait disruptions from stepping force signals: reproducibility archive
description:
Reproducibility materials for the state-history forecasting study: frozen seed-2026 analysis of 21 stepping-force recordings from seven participants, 385,035 saved forecast pairs and 88 cycle-derived reference onsets. Includes derived coordinates, saved predictions, reference intervals, evaluation tables, scripts and retained figures. Complete original force exports and trained checkpoints are not bundled; executable reproduction begins with saved coordinates and forecasts.

The primary endpoint is strict inter-event activation association without an upper lead limit; the 2T bounded evaluation is secondary. Association lead is not the approximately 1.5-second forecast horizon. Reference events are algorithmic gait disruptions, not independent clinical FOG annotations.

Version 1.0.1 adds archival metadata to the v1.0.0 materials. Scientific data and results are unchanged. Source-derived data retain the attribution in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.
